label: Дорога
description: A 10-sentence usage card for дорога with routes, surfaces, and travel logic.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Core adjective agreement. 1. 'Длинная' matches the feminine noun 'дорога'. 2. The phrase is easy to picture. 3. It is the basic descriptive form for route language.
Strategic focus: Destination framing. 1. 'В город' turns the noun into a path toward a place. 2. 'Дорога' remains the central noun. 3. This is a very common travel sentence.
Strategic focus: Motion route phrase. 1. 'По дороге' is a highly reusable travel frame. 2. 'Домой' completes the direction. 3. This is one of the most useful movement patterns in Russian.
Strategic focus: Object on a route. 1. 'На дороге' gives a clear physical location. 2. 'Машина' makes the sentence vivid. 3. The phrase is perfect for map and traffic language.
Strategic focus: Landmark relation. 1. 'У дороги' shows a location beside the road. 2. 'Дерево' is simple and concrete. 3. This sentence helps learners imagine a scene.
Strategic focus: Crossing relation. 1. 'Через дорогу' describes a crossing alignment. 2. 'Мост' gives the sentence a strong visual object. 3. This is useful for navigation and directions.
Strategic focus: Source relation. 1. 'С дороги' gives a source or removal context. 2. 'Снег' makes the scene seasonal and concrete. 3. The sentence is short but useful.
Strategic focus: Linear placement. 1. 'Вдоль дороги' is a strong spatial phrase. 2. 'Дома' gives the scene real scale. 3. This is a great route-description pattern.
Strategic focus: Functional path. 1. 'Ведет к' creates movement toward a target. 2. 'Станции' is a useful travel destination. 3. The sentence is practical for directions and maps.
Strategic focus: Descriptive environment. 1. 'На этой дороге' adds specificity. 2. 'Тихо' gives the scene atmosphere. 3. This is a strong sentence for observation and narration.
